doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Pensacola dance halls and water parks
summary: Halls in winter, parks and bath-house dance floors on the water in summer.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: What kind of places did they have over there that you played, Billy? Or the bands played? All kinds of places?

Yeah, we had... Halls that played in the winter. Parks in the summer. See? And in the summer we always was on... Our parks was on the water. You see? And in the winter time... They had the whole houses going. See? We had... We had... The Villa Street... Hall... Cole Street Hall... You know? You know... We saw...
Was the casino going then? No...

No... The casino wasn't going then. We had bath houses... You know... On the water then that time. Bath houses, see? The cabin, see? Had... The... The dance of the Villa sit right in the middle of the water. See? We danced out in the water... On the water. Like that. That's in the summertime.
